messages.content: You are an expert Python developer. Reply with one complete Python module inside a single ```python code block and nothing else. Use only the Python standard library.

Write `matmul(a: list[list[float]], b: list[list[float]]) -> list[list[float]]` that multiplies two matrices
given as lists of rows, without numpy.

Raise `ValueError` if either matrix is empty, has an empty row, is ragged (rows of different lengths),
or if the inner dimensions do not match.


The module will be saved as solution.py and tested with pytest (tests import from solution).
